content:
Field
Description
VmName
Name of the VM asset.
VmMoid
Managed Object ID of the VM.
VmUUID
Globally unique VM identifier, used to correlate managed VMs in cloud.
VmInstanceUuid
Unique VM identifier within a single vCenter instance.
VmPowerState
Power state of VM.
VmBootTime
Timestamp when the VM booted.
VmToolsStatus
Status of VM tools.
VmIpAddress
IP address of VM.
VmHostName
Hostname of VM. The hostname is a fully qualified domain name (FQDN).
HostType
Type of the host where the asset is running, typically HostSystem.
HostMoid
Managed Object ID of the Host (hypervisor).
HostSystemName Name of the Host on which the VM is running.
HostVendor
Vendor of the Host (hypervisor).
GuestId
ID of guest OS.
GuestOsFullName Full name of guest OS.
VmFalconAgentId ID of falcon agent that is installed the VM.
VCenterId
The VMware vCenter ID.
VCenterName
The VMware vCenter Name.
CaptureId
Capture ID of asset inventory snapshot.
